name: slack
title: Slack
description: One channel in a connected Slack workspace. Connect Slack first, then invite the bot to the channel and press Verify.

permission.slack.channels.read.why: Read the channels the app is in.

permission.slack.files.why: Read the files people share in the channel, and send files (`files:read`, `files:write`).

permission.slack.reactions.why: See the emoji people react with, and react as the app (`reactions:read`, `reactions:write`).

channel.label: Channel
channel.hint: Pick from the channels this workspace has, or type its ID. The ID is what is stored — a renamed channel keeps its ID, and keying on the name would fork its history. Watching several channels? Add one source per channel.

allowed_senders.label: Allowed senders
allowed_senders.hint: Who may drive the owning agent from this channel — Slack member IDs, one per line. Empty allows nobody.
